title: R13 standing monitor — third-party renderings of Kalshi vs this project's captured yes_bid/yes_ask
method: Daily. Renderers that display Kalshi (EBO's Kalshi row; 270toWin's panel) are compared with data/kalshi/universe/latest.json at the bid/ask midpoint; |diff| > 0.03 is flagged for review, never asserted as an error, because the renderer refreshes every 1-20 minutes and our capture is daily. DDHQ's odds are its own model and are stored as the context layer. Parse failures are recorded verbatim.
